# An import: Metallurgy I, less than 30 of the metal, none of it under way, fewer than 3 imports, the price.
DA_MET_can_import_Iron = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_MET_level_tt
		DA_completed.Metallurgy_1 = yes
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_MET_imp_below.Iron
		NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_Metal_owned_Iron value = 30 } }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_MET_imp_running.Iron
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_MET_import.Iron }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_MET_imp_most_tt
		NOT = { DA_MET_imports_full = yes }
	}
	treasury = 150
}

# The Alloy Library: a slot can be chosen when it is open and the Alloy Forge is not in use (as its own slot button).
DA_MET_can_select_C1 = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_MET_slot_open.C1
		has_global_modifier_value = { which = DA_fake_alloy_common_slot_adder value = 1 }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_alloy_unfinished_tt
		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_alloy_unfinished }
	}
}

		NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_alloy_unfinished }
	}
}
